remarks: **Charming Newly Renovated Studio Apartment in Glenbrook**  Welcome to your new home in the serene Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford! Nestled at the end of a peaceful deadend road, this beautifully renovated studio apartment offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience.  Step inside to discover a bright and inviting living space, featuring modern finishes. The open layout provides flexibility for your personal touch, making it easy to create your ideal living environment. The kitchen boasts updated appliances and plenty of counter space, perfect for culinary adventures or cozy meals at home.  Enjoy the tranquility of the lower-level apartment, complete with its own private entry and only minutes away from local shops, restaurants, and public transit.  This studio is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a peaceful retreat without sacrificing access to city amenities. Don't miss the opportunity to make this lovely space your own!
